originals: Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed receiver outperforms the baseline receiver in activity detection and channel estimation.
problem: 摘要独立阅读时，the baseline receiver 没有明确指代。
suggestion: Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed receiver outperforms the white-noise-trained GP-MP baseline in activity detection and channel estimation.
boundary: 明确正文已定义的比较对象；不扩大成优于全部基线。GP-MP 是本文对照名称，不是新增技术术语。

originals: The learned prior is then incorporated into a message-passing (MP) receiver with two modules: multi-frame linear estimation (MFLE), which suppresses inter-user interference; and generative-prior-aided joint denoising (GPJD), which performs minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) denoising.
problem: 一句同时介绍接收机、两个模块名、缩写和各自功能，阅读负担较集中；MP 在摘要只出现一次。原句语法成立。
suggestion: We incorporate the learned prior into a message-passing receiver with two modules: multi-frame linear estimation (MFLE) and generative-prior-aided joint denoising (GPJD). MFLE suppresses inter-user interference, while GPJD performs minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) denoising.
boundary: 仅拆句并去掉一次性 MP 缩写，模块名称、职责和 MMSE 表述保持；不是要求删掉所有缩写。原句也可保留。

priority: 内容选择；建议本轮暂不加
originals: outperforms the baseline receiver in activity detection and channel estimation.
problem: 结果句只有定性比较。加入量化结果可使贡献更具体，但目前摘要约 193 词，结构完整，不存在必须补数字才能成立的问题。
suggestion: 若决定增加，可接在结果句后：With known phases and fixed per-frame pilot energy at a received signal-to-noise ratio of 0 dB, the proposed receiver reaches a normalized mean-squared error of −14 dB using 25% fewer frames than GP-MP among the evaluated pilot-frame counts.
boundary: 这是将正文已验证结果加入摘要，不属于纯语言修正。24 对 32 帧的依据见上一轮核验；不能删除测试帧数、已知相位及能量条件，把它概括为普遍节省 25%。本轮倾向不加，避免结果句挤占方法说明。

originals: Its effective channel has three indices at each antenna, corresponding to Doppler, path delay, and the position of the received symbol along the delay dimension
problem: has three indices ... corresponding to 可以更直接，但原句没有技术或语法错误。
suggestion: At each antenna, its effective channel is indexed by Doppler, path delay, and the position of the received symbol along the delay dimension
boundary: Shen 的三个索引含义与原有引用保持；不为了压缩而把第三个索引误写成接收天线或删掉。

problem: DFT 首次出现时未展开。该段之后不再使用此缩写，直接写全称即可。
suggestion: Its modulator consists of an inverse discrete Fourier transform and multiplications by two diagonal chirp matrices
boundary: 只展开现有变换名称，保留 Bemani 引用；不新增 IDFT 缩写，不把 DFT 与 DAFT 混同。后续章节实际使用 DFT 缩写时，可在那一处再定义。

originals: To realize the full potential of AFDM-GFRA, accurate joint activity detection and channel estimation (JADCE) is a crucial prerequisite
problem: full potential 与 crucial prerequisite 叠加强调，没有增加具体技术信息；可以更直接。
suggestion: Accurate joint activity detection and channel estimation (JADCE) is essential for AFDM-GFRA
boundary: 保留 JADCE 的必要性及 Ding 引用。不是因为 crucial 命中词表就认定有问题，而是整句强调重复。

problem: CS 在引言只使用一次，括号缩写没有后续复用。原写法并不错误。
boundary: 只删除一次性缩写，compressed sensing 的含义、稀疏性论述及引用不变。

originals: For massive random access, \cite{ying2026} proposes a two-stage algorithm that first identifies active devices through a Transformer-based detector and then uses generative diffusion models for joint channel estimation and data detection.
Moreover, \cite{cai2026} computes activity probabilities using Gaussian extrinsic messages obtained after projecting the channel posterior onto a Gaussian distribution.
problem: 两个句子都以引用编号作动作主语。工程论文常见，但改成方法或被动结构时，操作对象更自然。
suggestion:
For massive random access, the two-stage algorithm in \cite{ying2026} first identifies active devices through a Transformer-based detector and then uses generative diffusion models for joint channel estimation and data detection.

Moreover, in \cite{cai2026}, activity probabilities are computed using Gaussian extrinsic messages obtained after projecting the channel posterior onto a Gaussian distribution.
boundary: 不改变对 Ying、Cai 的方法描述，不添加局限判断。两个位置可单独选择，不要求全篇改成同一种引文句法。

originals: A similar limitation has been highlighted for structured sensing matrices.
problem: similar limitation 与前句近似重复，has been highlighted 没有明确由谁指出。该句承接不到一个新的具体事实。
suggestion: 删除这一句。前句结尾 errors and the white Gaussian noise used for training. 直接接下一句 This mismatch can degrade channel denoising accuracy and, consequently, JADCE performance.
boundary: 这是删去一条泛指文献陈述，不包装成语法修正。此前移除 Wei 引用时作者要求保留对应论述，所以本轮必须等作者选定；不自动恢复旧引用，也不重开 M3。

originals: Additional pilot frames provide more observations without enlarging the channel tensor used by the learned prior.
problem: 第二章现已使用设备矩阵，网络部分才重排成三维数组；此处突然说 channel tensor，容易让人以为又引入不同对象。
suggestion: Additional pilot frames provide more observations without enlarging the effective-channel representation used by the learned prior.
boundary: 用已有 effective-channel representation 统一呈现层次。矩阵与网络数组是同一组系数的重排，不能把原句说成维度错误；不改变随帧数增加而保持信道表示大小的结论。
